title: RepForge modelManifest
description: Manifest of LiteRT adaptive-coach models served from the R2 CDN, per blueprint p.769. The Android client validates sha256 before caching a model file and enforces minAppVersion compatibility; rollout gates staged promotion (champion/challenger per plan todos 20-24).

manifestVersion.description: Monotonic version of this manifest document; incremented on every model promotion or rollback.

version.description: Monotonic integer model version; increments on every retrain that passes the promotion gate.

schemaVersion.description: Feature/input schema version the model was trained against; client refuses models whose schemaVersion it cannot build features for.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum app version (semver X.Y.Z) able to run this model.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest (64 hex chars) of the .tflite file bytes; validated by the client before caching.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the model object on the CDN.

rollout.description: Percentage of eligible devices (0-100) served this model version; enables staged champion/challenger promotion and atomic rollback.
